parsedVerdict.reasoning: This unit has one file, src/invoice/invoice.service.ts. Most of InvoiceService is about invoices: `issue(orderId, amount)` creates and saves an InvoiceEntity, and `countFor(orderId)` counts invoices for an order. `validateCreate(quantity: number)` doesn't fit. It checks a `quantity` value, but nothing in the invoice model uses one: `issue` takes `amount` and passes only `{ orderId, amount }` to the repository. `issue` also never calls `validateCreate`, so the rule is never enforced on the invoice path. It reads as an order or line-item rule ("Quantity must be positive") placed in the invoice service. That splits the service across two concerns and suggests the rule lives, or should live, somewhere else. The confidence is moderate because I can't see other modules to confirm the rule is duplicated, but the mismatch with the invoice abstraction shows up in this file alone.
